caption: Setup took about 7 steps and 2 minutes; we kept the default Accept / Reject / Preferences banner, which puts Reject next to Accept. The store name and address are hidden.

During our test a BFCM deal took 25% off for 3 months: Standard $7.5 (list $10), Plus $27.75 (list $37), Max $74.25 (list $99). Our dossier named the top plan Enterprise at $64. The store name is hidden.
Standard showed a 7 day trial to 24 Nov and $7.50 after the $2.50 discount, but Shopify asked for a payment method, so we did not approve it. The store name is hidden.
On Free the health check scored 71/100 with 6 issues, among them Google Consent Mode v2 not configured. That integration is listed under Standard, which we could not start. The store name is hidden.
After one click on Activate the banner with Reject, Preferences and Accept showed in the theme editor preview. We did not open the live storefront. The store name is hidden.
